items.title: Maude Johnson Interview, 1959-01-06
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] There was one piano player, a very good pianist, Lazy Daddy. ... [INTERVIEWEE] Phil Moore was his real name.

ctx.x: Oh, I forgot the name of the band. Let's see this band man. Which town was that? That was Port Arthur. Port Arthur. Yeah.
There was one piano player, a very good pianist, Lazy Daddy. I think he was in Galveston though. Did you remember ever hearing him? No, I don't remember that.
Phil Moore was his real name.
